executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, HBM, DRAM are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check from 2026-08-17 reviewed 8 current relevant items; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
